# Check — M0-c-03, S4 Backbone: closing check of @plat/layout's consolidation round R7 (lane check/M0-c-03-consolidate-close-1, 2026-10-12/13)

**Verdict: PASS.** This checker re-proved every line of the round with its own evidence: findings 1.4.1 – 1.4.8, §2's
comments for the backbone, §3's `test/backbone/` row, the frozen API (J263 Q1) and NO-SHIFT (J260 (3), J264 (5)).
Nothing is still failing, and no new finding is a blocker. The round changes no behaviour:

* **Output.** A probe ran the pre-round sources and the consolidated ones and gave byte-identical output over 55 runs.
  The runs are:
  * the CITY flat fixture, seeds 1 – 12;
  * `smallSite` 1 – 6;
  * the base chain through S4 on M0-x-06's small river frame, seeds 1 – 30 and the four registered seeds 3535584350,
    1192931101, 3207739920 and 3418200249;
  * the whole base chain on FLAT and RIVER at 900 / 30 ha (seed 1 for both, and RIVER seed 5).

  Each run records the arena's `bits` and `contentPrint`, S4's output and report, and the chain's model roots, stage
  roots and refusals.
* **Helpers.** Every replaced helper is bit-equal to the shared one it now calls. The check ran 400 000 seeded cases
  each, on lattice integers and on arbitrary doubles.
* **API.** The API is unchanged. Both index files are byte-identical, and so are the runtime barrel's 375 names. The
  only declaration added is the file-level `stage.ts` `heightsOf`.
* **Titles.** The 61 test titles are identical before and after.
* **Mutants.** 27 of the 29 targeted mutants are red. These include every oracle mutant the plan names, with X38 red in
  the form this round created (the shared `COS30`). Two survive: R04 (the fold's distance taken to a vertex) and X38 at
  `route.ts`'s own use of the cone. Both also survive on the pre-round sources and tests, so the round lost no kill.
  Neither changes any of the 55 probe runs. They are notes, not blockers.
* **Gates.** Every gate exits 0 and `landed:verify` is ok. NEAR is 11 files, 88 / 88. RELATED@1000 is 217 files,
  2 628 / 2 628.
* **Refusals.** S4 refused 0 runs before the round and 0 after.

Three notes rows (N-c1c-1 – N-c1c-3) are appended to `checks/M0-c-03-notes.md`.

Seat: the closing checker, independent of the author. Under the RESUME / CONTINUE rules the lane log was grepped
first, and it had no line for this key. The same grep printed the builder's CHECKPOINT and LANDED lines, which name its
probes and its mutants by id. This checker then planned its own probes (`zz-c1close-probe.test.ts`, `probe-eq.mts`)
and its own 29 mutants (`mutants.py`). Only after that did it open the builder's notes section, choices row C-0342 and
CLEAN-ROOM row L-0482. Those are judged here and are not used as evidence. The builder's `selfcheck-*` folder and its
`c03-c1/` scratch were not used, except that the `c03-c1/before` copy's SHA-256s were compared with this checker's
before-image (see Method).

Machine: `python3 tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib`, the
id the brief names. Node v24.12.0. `tools/test_budget.py` printed 1 for workers and 1 for mutants. No timing was taken
or gated on. No git command was run.

## Method

* **The before-image and its provenance.** No git could be run. The round re-landed `landed/M0-c-03.json`, so no record
  keeps the pre-round hashes. This checker took its before-image from a seat independent of the author:
  `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-x-02/mx/`, the mirror the M0-x-02 closing checker made at 05:18 on 2026-10-12. That was
  13 hours before the round's first CHECKPOINT (18:26). The image was checked rather than trusted, in three ways:
  * Its 21 files under `src/backbone/` and `test/backbone/` have the same SHA-256s as the builder's own `c03-c1/before`
    copy (21 / 21; for example `graph.ts` `c1d6e16f…`, `route.ts` `74a9e423…`, `stage.ts` `7593d533…`).
  * Every pre-round line number that the plan (written by another seat) cites matches it:
    * `junctions.ts:27 – 28` `const PI`, `const CDEG_PER_RAD`;
    * `route.ts:24` `const COS30`, `:105` `class WorkLimitReached`, `:265` `function dist`;
    * `graph.ts:256` `function footDist`, `:273` inside `orient`, `:277` `function meets`;
    * `stage.ts:68` `function heightsOf`, `:289` `function unit`;
    * `commit.ts:465`, the inline comparator.
  * The eight files the round did not touch (`classify.ts`, `index.ts`, `smooth.ts`, `types.ts`, `commit.test.ts`,
    `graph.test.ts`, `smooth.test.ts`, `stage.test.ts`) have the SHA-256s that the current `landed/M0-c-03.json`
    records for them (8 / 8).
* **Mirrors.** These are this checker's own, under `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-c-03/`. Each is a copy of `plat/` without
  `node_modules` and `*.tsbuildinfo`, installed `--frozen-lockfile` and built (each exit 0).
  * `after`: the tree. Its owns are SHA-256-equal to the tree's.
  * `before`: the tree with `src/backbone/` and `test/backbone/` replaced by the before-image. `diff -rq` against
    `after` differs in exactly five sources (`commit`, `graph`, `junctions`, `route`, `stage`) and eight test files
    (`backbone`, `classify`, `frame`, `junctions`, `route`, `span`, `water` and `support`). Every hunk was read whole,
    and each one is one of the plan's edits; see (1).
  * Mutants ran in `m1` (a copy of `after`) and the pre-round controls ran in `m0` (a copy of `before`). Each ran one at
    a time with `--maxWorkers=1 --bail=1` against `packages/layout/test/backbone/`. Each patched file was restored by
    copy and then `cmp`-checked against its mirror's original (`restored: true` for all 31 runs).
  * The probe files lived only in the mirrors. Every mirror's `node_modules` was deleted at the end.

## (3) New findings, judged by the blocker rule

None is a blocker. No gate exits non-zero. Every listed interface and test id is present: the backbone index is
byte-identical and the 61 titles are identical. The source diff adds no stub or shortcut (grep: no `TODO`, `FIXME`,
`.skip` or `.only` in `src/backbone`/`test/backbone`, and the only `notBuilt` is the declared extra-bridge rung, M1,
C-0076). No honest input gives a wrong result (55 byte-identical runs). No path lies outside `plat/`. The notes, for
M4 or the session:

* **N-c1c-1** (M4). R04 survives before and after the round, and the 55 probe runs are byte-identical under it. So
  `foldParallel`'s nearness is pinned only by outputs, not by its measure: C-0236 (16) says "within the class
  separation … of an earlier part", which is the distance to that part's segments, not to its vertices.
* **N-c1c-2** (M4). X38 at `route.ts`'s own deck cone (60°) survives before and after, and the 55 runs are
  byte-identical under it. The plan's oracle "X38 killed" holds for the shared `COS30` (X38s), which the round's new
  pin kills. This confirms the builder's N-c1b-2 with this checker's own evidence.
* **N-c1c-3** (the session). Two items:
  * The small-river S3 refusal at seed 27 is confirmed independently (N-c1b-3).
  * The builder's clean-room disclosure is classed as not a breach, following the precedent the notes cite.

## Comments (§2; a comment that no longer matches the code is a blocker)

Every changed comment was read against the code:

* **Sources.**
  * `graph.ts:256`: "Do the closed segments pq and s meet? Exact: siting's `segmentsMeet` on s's two ends." This is true
    (see 1.4.5).
  * The removed helpers' headers went with them: `route.ts`'s "cos 30° … (M0-c-01's reading, C-0201 (4))" and
    "The distance between two points", and `junctions.ts`'s "π to the double nearest it".
  * Their substance stands at the kept definitions: `siting/lattice.ts:13` "cos 30°: a deck edge runs within 30° of its
    deck's direction (C-0201 (4))", `geom.ts:15`, and `routes.ts:31` "A search stopped at the work limit (F-WORK) …".
  * No comment in `src/backbone/` cites a removed name (grep for `footDist`, `orient(`, `unit(`, "plain double" and
    "M0-c-01's reading": 0 hits, apart from `junctions.ts`'s own different `unit`).
* **Test headers.**
  * `frame.test.ts` cites N-54 (2) and C-0289 (decks with both ends in the frame), C-0297 (the re-solve round a
    given-up deck) and C-0304 (the unserved part counted; a deck's crossing run holds only wet edges). Each matches the
    row (read in `choices.md`) and the tests below it.
  * `route.test.ts`'s rewritten paragraph states C-0289, C-0297 and C-0304's `deckOf` rule, as `route.ts:31`'s
    contract and `:78 – 79` implement it.
  * `water.test.ts`'s header and two inline comments are now shape descriptions. The describe title "(C-0250;
    integration g12 B-3, B-4)" stays verbatim, rightly (§2: a title is an oracle's name).
  * `backbone.test.ts`'s two lines now cite C-0239 and C-0236 (10).
  * The three new assertions' comments state what they assert. The arms are in UTF-16 code-unit order (default
    `sort()` on strings = `compareKeys`). The deflection lands "just over" the minimum (< 3000 + 2 × 100). Each
    deck-carrying edge is within 30° (√3 ÷ 2 written out; `Math.sqrt(3) / 2` is one ulp below `COS30`, so the
    assertion is the code's cone or looser).
* **Round narration.** No comment in the owns narrates a round, cites a queue row or a check's finding id outside a
  title (grep for "session round", "checks/M0", `Q\d+`, `B-\d`, "no longer", "retired", "this round": 0 hits).

`gate:1/out`) are the ladder's designed rung (C-0304), not refusals, and are equal before and after.
